cards.card_text: Jesus says one word to the deaf man: “Ephphatha!” It means “Be ___!” opened still strong
cards.verse_text: And looking up to heaven, He sighed deeply and said to him, “Ephphatha!” (which means, “Be opened!”).
cards.snippet: And looking up to heaven, He sighed deeply and said to him, “Ephphatha!” (which means, “Be opened!”).
